description: This file defines the LinkFieldDisplayDriver class responsible for rendering, editing, and updating LinkField content in OrchardCore CMS. It manages display and editing logic, including URL validation and sanitization.

classes.name: LinkFieldDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for LinkField, handling display, editing, and update logic including URL validation and sanitization.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Generates the display shape for a LinkField, specifying locations for detail and summary views.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the editing shape for a LinkField, setting default values if creating new.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the update process for a LinkField, including URL validation, sanitization, and error reporting.
